paras: 01 Day Jaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR001
Rs.1899/- per person
Day: 01 – Jaipur
Upon arrival at Jaipur, our representative will give you a warm welcome at Jaipur Airport or Railway Station. Soon after, we will embark on an exciting tour of the Pink city, including:
Hawa Mahal: The iconic "Palace of Winds"
City Palace: A royal combination of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture
Jantar Mantar: The famous astronomical observatory
Jal Mahal: The pretty "Water Palace"
Amer Fort: The wonderful hilltop fortress
Nahargarh Fort & Palaces: Offering spectacular views of Jaipur
By the evening, you will be dropped off at Jaipur Airport or Railway Station, marking the end of a memorable tour of the Pink City.
Package Inclusions:
* Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes
* Government-approved tourist guide service for sightseeing in Jaipur
Package Exclusions:
* Personal expenses such as tips, telephone calls
* Entrance fees to monuments and attractions
* Camera fees
* Any tickets for trains, flights, or buses
* Travel insurance
Things to note
* Rates may vary during peak seasons such as New Year and Diwali.

01 Day Udaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR003
Rs.1999/- per person
Day : 01 – Udaipur

Upon your arrival at Udaipur Airport or Railway Station, our representative will warmly welcome you. We will then proceed to explore the enchanting city of Udaipur, visiting these must-see attractions:
City Palace: A majestic complex with stunning architecture and rich history
Fateh Sagar Lake: A peaceful and picturesque lake
Jagdish Temple: An antique and beautifully carved temple devoted to Lord Vishnu
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: A museum showcasing Rajasthani folk art and culture
Saheliyon Ki Bari: A beautiful garden decorated with fountains and marble pavilions
Shilpgram: A rural arts and crafts village
By evening, you will be dropped off at Udaipur Airport or Railway Station, marking the end of a memorable tour of this beautiful city.
